name: rankine_cycle_60mw
title: Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam power plant
summary: Simple Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 °C, 0.2 bar condenser): steam flow rate, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, cycle efficiency, back-work ratio; state points as arrays for the diagrams.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquee (ULiege, MECA0002), exercise session R07, exercise 1; 2017 original THD10_R06_E1

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file R07_E01_2022.EES (44 variables)
verification.notes: All 40 common variables agree within 2e-5 relative after the manual kPa/kJ/kW -> Pa/J/W conversion (compare_solution.py --ees-units); m, n, R, W_dot_alt are leftover variables of the EES file, absent from the equations. The 2017 version (TM-0519) and the zipped copy (TM-0547) are duplicates; the CoolSolve example rankine1 (CSX-036) is the same exercise with a 0.1 bar condenser.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/rankine1.eescode (CSX-036): same exercise in SI units with a 0.1 bar condenser

history.action: added (task C-03: merge of duplicate group DG-0106, TM-0519/TM-0547 duplicates, CSX-036 superseded)
